name: DGLD Tokenized Gold
oneLiner: DGLD is Gold Token SA's tokenized physical gold from Swiss vaults, each token redeemable for 1 troy ounce of allocated LBMA PAMP-refined gold.
collateral: LBMA Good Delivery PAMP® gold bars allocated in insured Swiss vaults operated by MKS PAMP SA (1 DGLD = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for physical PAMP® gold through Gold Token SA; minimum 1 gram, no custody or transfer fees

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: As of June 30 2026, DGLD closed the Ethereum-Base bridge path and redeployed Base as an independently gold-backed native issuance. Cross-chain exposure is issuer-managed multichain mint/redeem rather than a live canonical rollup bridge supply path.

mintAuthority.summary: DGLD is issued by Gold Token SA. On Ethereum the MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a single issuer EOA that also owns the ProxyAdmin. After retiring the compromised Ethereum-Base bridge, the issuer deployed an independently gold-backed native Base token whose MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and ProxyAdmin owner are separately identified.

mintIncidents.summary: An exploit of the former Ethereum-Base bridge enabled unauthorized unbacked DGLD minting on Base. Gold Token SA retired that bridge, deployed a separately backed native Base token on June 30, and completed the legacy Base balance reset on July 15.

controls.evidence: Gold Token SA mints DGLD against allocated PAMP gold bars (1 DGLD = 1 troy oz) and burns on 1:1 physical redemption; supply is issuer-controlled with no permissionless mint route.

controls.label: DGLD Ethereum MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE — issuer EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540331, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb1c1bc081e49b8f4bb4e1960c2f7d9cd9dff8b9d) and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xb1c1bc081e49b8f4bb4e1960c2f7d9cd9dff8b9d) both returned true; eth_getCode returned 0x. The DGLD proxy 0xa9299c296d7830a99414d1e5546f5171fa01e9c8 has implementation 0x5ee71b30db71cee806f0d5cbbd57bfe1da3b2875 and EIP-1967 admin 0xd8b4395aafd4076ad7fa5b8c0bcd6da79750e629, whose owner is the same EOA.

The replacement native DGLD proxy is 0xe908475f8beb7a138b0dc6eb5a05cb27068ffb9a after the issuer retired the former bridge representation.

controls.label: DGLD Ethereum ProxyAdmin owner — issuer EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540331, the token EIP-1967 admin slot resolved to ProxyAdmin 0xd8b4395aafd4076ad7fa5b8c0bcd6da79750e629 and that contract's owner() returned this no-code EOA. The verified OpenZeppelin ProxyAdmin exposes owner-only upgrade and upgradeAndCall methods, so this owner can replace the DGLD mint implementation without a timelock.

upgradeability.controlRef: DGLD Ethereum ProxyAdmin owner — issuer EOA

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25540331, DGLD's MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and its ProxyAdmin owner all resolve to issuer EOA 0xb1c1bc081e49b8f4bb4e1960c2f7d9cd9dff8b9d. At Base block 48678413, the replacement native DGLD token's MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and ProxyAdmin owner all resolve to issuer EOA 0xe003a81a40803fedb701870c589c0a96d14544a0. Both transparent-proxy implementations and immediate upgrade paths are recorded. The issuer's February bridge-mint incident was resolved by retiring the bridge and replacing the Base deployment.
